settings.heading: Shop. Collect. Redeem.
settings.text: Earn points on purchases and plenty of small actions, then turn them into dollars off. Your tier is based on what you spend in a year, so loyalty speeds up your points.
settings.image_alt: Gift box of skin and body care products

settings.text: Create a free account and get 50 points as a welcome gift.

settings.title: Earn
settings.text: One point for every dollar, plus extra points for reviews, referrals and social follows.

settings.title: Redeem
settings.text: Swap 500 points for $5 off, 1,000 for $10 and 1,500 for $15 at checkout.

settings.title: Refer a friend
settings.text: Earn 1,000 points when a friend makes a first purchase, and they get $10 off.

settings.title: Place three orders in a year
settings.text: A bonus lands once you hit your third order.

settings.title: Sign up for email and texts
settings.text: Fifty points for each channel you join.

settings.title: Celebrate your birthday
settings.text: A points gift and a discount code arrive in your birthday month.

settings.title: Write a review
settings.text: Text reviews earn points and photo reviews earn more.

settings.title: Follow and read
settings.text: Ten points per social follow and per journal article you finish.

settings.label: Do points expire?
settings.text: Yes. Points expire after three months with no activity, so any order or review resets the clock.

settings.label: Is there a minimum to redeem?
settings.text: Your cart needs to be at least $30, and you can use up to 1,500 points per order.

settings.label: Can I stack points with a promo code?
settings.text: No. Points and promo codes cannot be combined on the same order.

settings.label: What happens to points if I return something?
settings.text: Points earned on the returned item are removed from your balance.

settings.label: How long does my tier last?
settings.text: Once you reach a tier you keep it for the full year.

settings.heading: Join for early looks and offers
settings.message: Email and text sign-ups get a welcome discount, new launch alerts and the occasional routine guide.
